empty.title: Start with a series
empty.paste: Paste the link to a series in the bar above (or use its Paste button). A link to any of its chapters works too.
empty.listed: Its chapters will be listed here, ready to pick and save for your reader.

failed.title: Couldn't load this series
failed.hint: Check that the link opens the series in a browser. Sites behind a Cloudflare check may need Show the browser window, under Options › Advanced.

pickMissingHint: Select and highlight the chapters that aren't in the folder
pickFailedHint: Select and highlight the chapters that failed or were cancelled

delete.hint: Move this series' files to the Recycle Bin, after asking
delete.title: Delete this series?
delete.bodyWhole_one: Move the {{title}} folder, {{folder}}, to the Recycle Bin: {{count}} file, {{size}}.
delete.bodyWhole_other: Move the {{title}} folder, {{folder}}, to the Recycle Bin: {{count}} files, {{size}}.
delete.bodyFiles_one: Move {{count}} chapter file of {{title}} ({{size}}) from {{folder}} to the Recycle Bin. Other series' files there stay.
delete.bodyFiles_other: Move {{count}} chapter files of {{title}} ({{size}}) from {{folder}} to the Recycle Bin. Other series' files there stay.
delete.progress: Moving to the Recycle Bin: {{done}} of {{total}}
delete.permanentLine: This drive has no Recycle Bin: the files will be deleted for good and can't be restored.

permanent.title: No Recycle Bin on this drive
permanent.body_one: {{dir}} has no Recycle Bin. Delete {{count}} duplicate file ({{size}}) for good? It can't be restored.
permanent.body_other: {{dir}} has no Recycle Bin. Delete {{count}} duplicate files ({{size}}) for good? They can't be restored.

rangeLabel: Chapter range to add to the selection

parts.none: No chapter of this series is split in parts, so each one gets a file as usual.
parts.partialHint: Only the selected parts go in its file

locked: Locked, so it cannot be selected

mark.done: Downloaded: its file is in the folder
mark.failed: Failed: pick it to download it again
mark.cancelled: Cancelled before it was saved: pick it to download it again

downloadMissingHint: Download every chapter of this series that isn't in the folder yet, the failed and cancelled ones included. Chapters already saved and those downloading now are left alone.

duplicates.language: Some numbers are listed once per language; the language tag tells them apart.
duplicates.group: Some numbers are listed once per group; the group tag tells them apart.

hint.volume: Click a volume to pick all of its chapters · <kbd>←</kbd><kbd>→</kbd> fold · <kbd>Space</kbd> toggles
hint.part: Click a chapter to pick all of its parts · <kbd>←</kbd><kbd>→</kbd> fold · <kbd>Space</kbd> toggles
